meta.name: Shōsai design tokens
meta.role: The single tracked design-token source for the Flutter frontend (lib/theme_tokens.dart). Generated and checked by scripts/generate-theme-tokens.py; the generated file may not be edited by hand. Since 2026-10-21 the colors, radii and type families are the Shōsai design system (docs/design-system.md, tokens in docs/design-system/tokens.json): the Bookshelf look, D1 paper (2026-10-20), the 丸に書 mark (2026-10-21) and the Inter + Literata type set (2026-10-21). The type sizes and layout metrics are still the pinned Iced reference until the Bookshelf composition replaces them.
meta.reference_subject: main@origin #108 (refactor(flutter): organize the frontend into Elm modules mirroring Iced)

authority.color: Design system (docs/design-system/tokens.json, the Bookshelf look, D1 paper)
authority.app: Design system light theme (references into color.light)
authority.app.dark: Design system dark theme (references into color.dark)
authority.reader: Design system page themes (references into color.page*)
authority.radius: Design system (docs/design-system/tokens.json radius-*); small, medium and progress equal sm, md and xs
authority.size: Design system (docs/design-system/tokens.json size tokens; measure is in em)
authority.layout.library.card: Iced (crates/shosai-app/src/app.rs render_book_card and crates/shosai-app/src/widgets.rs book_button, the pinned reference)
authority.layout.library.card.placeholderPadding: Retained Flutter: the pinned Iced placeholder centres its label with no inset; this inset keeps a long or scaled label's ink inside the placeholder box.
authority.layout.library.card.triggerScrimAlpha: Retained Flutter: owner-directed refinement of the pinned card trigger (2026-09-25). Iced paints the trigger as an opaque SURFACE square with a 1 px BORDER (theme.rs book_card_action); the owner asked for a subtler trigger, so the reference's painted geometry keeps its 13 px glyph, [5, 8] padding and radiusSmall but is filled with this translucent ink scrim (app.shadow.base) under a light glyph (app.textOnAccent) instead.
authority.layout.library.card.triggerScrimActiveAl: Retained Flutter: the same refinement's hovered, pressed and open-menu weight of the trigger scrim; the reference's own hover only swaps SURFACE for SURFACE_MUTED.
authority.layout.readerChrome: Iced (crates/shosai-app/src/app.rs reader chrome, the pinned reference)
authority.layout.readerPanel: Iced (crates/shosai-app/src/app.rs reader panels: reader_settings, reader_more_panel, bookmarks_panel and search_bar, the pinned reference)
authority.layout.library.skeleton: Iced (crates/shosai-app/src/app.rs library_refresh_placeholder and render_loading_book_card, the pinned reference)
authority.layout.library.emptyState: Iced (crates/shosai-app/src/app.rs library_collection's empty composition, the pinned reference)
authority.layout.library.alertPadding: Iced (crates/shosai-app/src/app.rs library_collection's failure alert padding [7, 14], the pinned reference)
authority.layout.library.continueSectionTrailingSp: Iced (crates/shosai-app/src/app.rs library_collection's Space between the continue card and the next section, the pinned reference)
authority.layout.library.pagingTriggerDistance: Retained Flutter: the pinned Iced library pages with an explicit previous/next row; the owner asked for automatic next-page loading (2026-09-25), so this is the distance from the scroll end at which the next page is requested. It has no reference value.

notes: Since 2026-10-21 color.* transcribes docs/design-system/tokens.json token for token: a kebab-case design-system name becomes camelCase (ink-muted is color.light.inkMuted, ShosaiTokens.colorLightInkMuted), themed tokens sit under color.light and color.dark, and a value written {path} references another token. The Bookshelf look, D1 paper (2026-10-20); the 丸に書 mark colors brand-mark, brand-navy and brand-cream (2026-10-21). The design system's layered shadows are CSS box-shadow lists and are not transcribed.

app.* and app.dark.* are the roles the Flutter Shad and Material themes read, as references into color.light and color.dark. Retained component names from the Iced era (sidebar, readerControls, tabStrip, panel) read chrome; app.dark maps background = canvas, card, popover and secondary = surface, primary and ring = accent, muted = surface-sunken, accent and selection = accent-soft, border = line, input = line-strong, and destructiveForeground = canvas because the design system has no on-danger token. app.shadow.cover, menu, modal and hairline keep the Iced single-layer weights over the design system's shadow ink.

reader.<light,dark,sepia> reference the design system's page-paper, page-night and page-sepia, with search-hit and search-current in every theme. The table-header colors and reader.codeBlock.fallbackBackground have no design-system token and keep the pinned Iced reference values.

type.family follows the default type set inter-literata (Inter and Noto Sans JP for the interface, Literata and Shippori Mincho for editorial text). The iced keys record the removed application's names for the interface and math faces; editorial has no iced key because Iced never used Literata.

Plan decision 2 rejected the historical #109 brown accent (#8A6338); it must not reappear. The accent is the design system's slate (#2B3A5C on light grounds, 2026-10-20), which replaced the pinned Iced slate #4D5E86.
Interface fonts and document fonts are separate: type.family.ui.* is interface chrome only, while EPUB book text keeps the document font or the reader preference.

Reader palettes are the document/page palettes (spec 3.3). Reader chrome uses the application palette for the light reader and the reader palette family for the dark and sepia readers, which Iced does not define.

app.shadow.hairline and reader.codeBlock.fallbackBackground are transcribed from the pinned Iced sources so that no literal theme color remains in the application modules; the reference specification's token tables name the styles they cover and are not extended by these entries.

layout.library.card.* and layout.library.collectionPadding* are transcribed from the pinned Iced library collection (app.rs render_book_card, widgets.rs book_button and app.rs library_collection). The specification's 3.5 table names the grid metrics and its prose names the collection padding [22, 24]; the card's internal metrics are recorded here so the Flutter card and the Iced card cannot drift. The pinned Iced card still writes these values literally in app.rs; migrating the Rust side is not part of this entry.

layout.continueCard.*, layout.library.skeleton.*, layout.library.emptyState.*, layout.library.sectionSpacing, layout.library.alertPadding* and layout.library.continueSectionTrailingSpace are transcribed from the same pinned library collection (app.rs render_continue_card, library_refresh_placeholder, render_loading_book_card and library_collection) for package 3C. The pinned Iced app still writes them literally; migrating the Rust side is not part of this entry.

layout.library.pagingTriggerDistance is Retained Flutter: the pinned Iced library has an explicit previous/next paging row (app.rs library_collection) and no scroll-driven paging, so this value is the owner-directed automatic-paging distance and is not a reference transcription.

layout.readerChrome.* is transcribed from the pinned Iced reader chrome (app.rs reader_header, tabs_view, status_bar, edge navigation, opening_document and the reader alert) for package 4B, which owns the reader presentation and asked for these entries through 3C, the token source's owner at the time. The pinned Iced app still writes them literally; migrating the Rust side is not part of this entry.

layout.readerPanel.* is transcribed from the pinned Iced reader panels (app.rs reader_settings, reader_more_panel, bookmarks_panel and search_bar) for package 4C, which owns the panel bodies and asked for these entries through the token source's owner at the time. The pinned Iced app still writes them literally; migrating the Rust side is not part of this entry.
